findings.title: Fix the invalid Ruby closing the header conditional
findings.body: `<%- end if %>` is not a valid closing statement for this conditional: the trailing `if` has no condition. Rendering the best template therefore raises a template syntax error, so every embed with an existing topic fails instead of displaying comments. Use `end` and add a controller test that actually renders this view; the current mocked controller tests do not exercise the template.

findings.title: Sanitize imported HTML before storing it as cooked content
findings.body: Feed content reaches this method directly from PollFeed and is stored with the raw_html cook method, which returns the input without sanitization. `absolutize_urls` only parses and rewrites links; it does not remove scripts, event handlers, or unsafe URL schemes. Consequently, active HTML in a feed entry executes in the forum origin when the imported post is viewed. Sanitize the final HTML on both creation and revision, including the imported-from link, whose URL is also interpolated without HTML escaping.

findings.title: Handle RSS entries that expose description instead of content
findings.body: The poller unconditionally calls `i.content.scrub`, but valid RSS entries commonly contain only `description` (or `content:encoded`) rather than Atom's `content` field. For such an entry, `i.content` is nil and the job raises instead of importing it or processing subsequent entries. Select the available body field and handle entries without a body; add tests using actual RSS and Atom payloads rather than only testing delegation to poll_feed.

findings.title: Resolve relative URLs against the article URI
findings.body: The URL rewriting treats all references beginning with `/` as paths on the article host. A protocol-relative image such as `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg` is therefore changed to `http://article-host/cdn.example.com/image.jpg`. Conversely, path-relative references such as `images/photo.jpg` and `../other-article` are left unchanged and resolve against the forum URL when displayed. This breaks images and links in imported articles. Resolve both href and src with URI reference resolution against the complete source URL instead of concatenating the host.
